concept: A welcoming shared-hearth gathering garden whose lantern warmth grows brighter in good company.
floor: One broad continuous warm terracotta hearth floor across the full top face, made from a few oversized softly beveled slabs without sparks, cracks, small grout, or a central gathering ring.
main_structure: One broad open-front timber hearth pavilion at the rear with a simple glowing firebox and a gently arched amber roof.
rear_props: one large shared supper table with four chunky stools placed close to the rear pavilion
side_props: one broad curved conversation bench and one lantern post on the upper-left edge
one simple tea trolley and two rounded ember planters on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth warm terracotta garden wall with broad rounded capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized linked-loop and ember emblems

materials: a few broad honey-gold stone blocks

lighting: soft warm dusk lighting from one broad hearth glow and two or three large amber lanterns
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open hearth floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny tableware, food pieces, fairy lights, sparks, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
